name: Scanline-Based V-Buffer Algorithm
definition: A sequential volume rendering algorithm that converts volumetric data into a set of polygons (triangles) and uses a scanline-based approach with a V-Buffer (linked list of polygons per pixel) to determine ray intersections and perform compositing.
summary: The Scanline-Based V-Buffer Algorithm renders volumes by converting data to polygons and using a linked list per pixel to store all intersecting polygons for compositing, avoiding depth testing.
